items.title: Blumhouse Productions, LLC
items.summary: Blumhouse Productions, LLC is an American film Production company founded by Jason Blum and Amy Israel in 2000.  The company is known for making horror films such as the Paranormal Activity series, Get Out, and Split.

items.title: Chica's Party World
items.summary: Chica's Party World was a restaurant owned by Chica's Restaurants that commissioned Murray's Costume Manor for animatronics in Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic.  It was first mentioned in the source code of Scottgames.

items.title: Party Time Chica
items.summary: Party Time Chica is a mascot suit that debuts in Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic as a suit that the Mimic wears.

items.title: Five Nights at Freddy's (Mobile)
items.summary: The mobile port for Five Nights at Freddy's was first released for Android on August 25, 2014 and iOS on September 11, 2014.  Both ports cost $2.

items.title: The Rat
items.summary: The Rat, also known as RAT, is the main antagonist of the Five Nights at Candy's series, acting as the main antagonist of Five Nights at Candy's and Five Nights at Candy's 2.

items.title: Monster Rat
items.summary: Monster Rat is the monstrous version of the Rat conjured in the nightmares of Mary Schmidt.  He is the main antagonist of Five Nights at Candy's 3.

items.title: Monster Vinnie
items.comment: Yeah, no. He's final antagonist to appear. Not the guy caused the whole chaos through the series.
items.summary: Monster Vinnie is a monster version of Vinnie and the final antagonist of Five Nights at Candy's 3.
